subject: general
question: A revised version of the 'India-Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement' was adopted by the two countries under which amendment to the Construction of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**100th Constitutional Amendment Bill, 2015**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **100th Constitutional Amendment Bill, 2015** facilitated the implementation of the **India-Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement (LBA)**.
 
• This amendment involved the **exchange of enclaves and the demarcation of the boundary between India and Bangladesh**, which had been pending since the agreement was signed in **1974**.
 
• The amendment aimed to resolve long-standing border disputes and improve bilateral relations between the two countries.
 
• As part of the agreement, India and Bangladesh exchanged **162 enclaves**, with 51 enclaves being transferred to Bangladesh and 111 to India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Land Boundary Agreement** was first signed in 1974 between the then Prime Minister of India, Indira Gandhi, and the Prime Minister of Bangladesh, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
 
• The agreement aimed to address the issue of enclaves and adverse possessions along the India-Bangladesh border.
 
• The 100th Amendment Bill was passed by the Indian Parliament in **May 2015 **and received the President's assent in the same month.
 
• This historic agreement was seen as a significant step towards enhancing the diplomatic and strategic relationship between India and Bangladesh.
